objective: At /start (ob_start), print one line per partner seat saying whether that seat is listening, so a planner learns a seat is not polling instead of finding out from an unread-by line an hour later.
tasks: read the hub's presence endpoint and filter the roster by seat name on the client, because the endpoint ignores an agents filter
print one line per partner seat: <seat>: polling | not polling, N unread since <time>
take the seat names and rooms from T-196's tracked data file once it exists, and until then from a named interim source, saying in the output which source was read
never fail silently: a timeout, a non-2xx response or an unparseable body prints presence: UNKNOWN (<cause>), with a bounded timeout so /start never hangs
say which process makes the call, because a check served through the MCP server cannot report that server's own staleness (G-033)
out_of_scope: replacing the interim source of seat names, which is T-196's step
any test that calls the live hub: tests use a fixture HTTP server only
preserve: every existing ob_start section and the tests that cover them, unchanged
the greeting-size limit is reported, not silently exceeded: the one new block is measured against it (T-183)

acceptance.observable: A seat with pollingNow true in its room prints as polling
A seat that is not polling and has unread turns prints the count and the age
With the hub unreachable, non-2xx or malformed, one visible UNKNOWN line with its cause is printed, never nothing
A partner seat absent from the presence roster prints as absent, not skipped
A mutant that swallows the fetch error goes red on PR-3, on its own branch and clean under tsc --noEmit
Every existing ob_start section and its tests are unchanged, and the new block's size against the greeting limit is reported as a number

repair_targets: tracked text does not make a planner check its seats: builder and Forge sat on dispatches for about an hour and the planner learned it only from a listener's unread-by line
new_capability: ob_start shows whether each partner seat is listening, and says visibly when the hub cannot be reached
